messages:
Jordan: Heads up — Velora renewal is blocked on procurement vendor code; legal already signed but procurement says no PO until vendor_code matches their system.
Maya: Got it. Do we have the exact vendor_code they need?
Sam: Procurement sent this back: they require vendor_code = VEL-INC-US-01 and billing_entity to match our US legal name. No PO until that field is set.
Maya: Can we do a split-pay / CC fallback so they can sign now and issue PO later? Customer is willing to do CC for first month.
Alex: Pricing will change if term shortens — note: customer asked to change from 12mo to 9mo during negotiaton. Need updated quote.
Sam: Procurement is strict; they need vendor code in Doc record before their AP will accept a PO. If we do CC fallback we still need vendor_code in our systems for the eventual PO.
Maya: Copying the vendor code from Sam to make sure it's exact.
Sam: Exact snippet they provided:
```
vendor_code: VEL-INC-US-01
billing_entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US)
```
Maya: Thanks. I'll update DocuSign meta and add procurement@velora.com as cc on the envelope so procurement sees the signed copy.
Priya_legal: Quick legal note — shortening term to 9mo requires one-line amendment; pricing must reflect pro rata. Approve with amended notice clause (30 days).
Alex: New quote calc for 9mo: list price for 12mo was $10,800 (annual). Pro-rated 9mo = $8,100. I'll upload a new quote link: https://app.redwood/quotes/QR-5567 (revops).
Maya: Perfect. I'll attach the quote to the DocuSign envelope and set signer order: Exec (customer) -> Procurement (cc only).
Jordan: Also, procurement wants a vendor code field on the invoice PDF. Can billing-bot include vendor_code on next invoice?
billing-bot: Confirmed — can include vendor_code field. Will mark invoice draft with vendor_code: VEL-INC-US-01 once Maya confirms PO or CC path.
Maya: Sending updated DocuSign now. @Priya_legal can you confirm the signature block change is acceptable?
Priya_legal: Approved. Add this sentence to clause 2.1: "Term adjusted to nine (9) months per mutual agreement."
legal-bot: Noted: clause update queued, sending updated contract to DocuSign.
Maya: DocuSign sent at 15:22 PST. Envelope includes quote and invoice split instructions. Procurement cc included.
Sam: I updated our vendor registry with VEL-INC-US-01 and linked procurement contact procurement@velora.com. AP will issue PO once they reconcile the code — expected within 5 business days.
Jordan: Customer emailed: "We'll sign ASAP if vendor code is present on the docs. Confirmed we can do CC for first month."
Maya: Marking follow-up: if PO not received in 7 days, process CC charge for first month and hold remainder pending PO.
billing-bot: Action: CC fallback enabled for invoice #INV-8842. PO slot awaiting vendor code.
Maya: Thanks team — will chase AP in two days and update thread. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Closing loop for now. If procurement refuses PO after code update we escalate to account exec. :eyes:
_meta: Generated Slack thread for renewal execution: vendor code, split signature, CC fallback, term change — conforms to agents.md (single-thread string, participants list, timestamps).
